title.narrative: Rafforzamento della resilienza alimentare ed economica delle famiglie e delle comunità di Ouagadougou
Strengthening the food and economic resilience of households and communities in Ouagadougou

description.narrative: Questo progetto mira a rafforzare la resilienza delle comunità più vulnerabili e di quelle più esposte all'insicurezza alimentare e nutrizionale nelle aree target attraverso un approccio integrato multisettoriale. Attraverso attività di sviluppo rurale, educazione all’agroecologia, restaurazione dei suoli e il sostegno alla produzione, aiuterà le famiglie e le comunità vulnerabili della Regione Centro, compresi gli sfollati interni, ad adattarsi agli effetti del cambiamento climatico, a passare a un'agricoltura agro-ecologica redditizia e a sviluppare catene di valore per una crescita economica green, con l'obiettivo generale di migliorare la sicurezza alimentare e nutrizionale a lungo termine.

This project aims to strengthen the resilience of the most vulnerable communities and those most exposed to food and nutrition insecurity in the target areas through an integrated multi-sectoral approach. Through rural development activities, agroecology education, soil restoration, and production support, it will help vulnerable households and communities in the Central Region, including internally displaced persons, to adapt to the effects of climate change, transition to profitable agro-ecological agriculture, and develop value chains for green economic growth, with the overall goal of improving long-term food and nutrition security.

tag.narrative: By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment
By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round

By 2030, ensure sustainable food production systems and implement resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production, that help maintain ecosystems, that strengthen capacity for adaptation to climate change, extreme weather, drought, flooding and other disasters and that progressively improve land and soil quality
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
